# Syntalix LLP — AI/ML Consultancy, AI Consulting & AEO Services
> Syntalix Consultancy (Syntalix LLP, LLPIN: ACR-6280) is a registered AI/ML engineering and AI consulting firm based in Uttar Pradesh, India, serving enterprises across Gujarat, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, West Bengal (Kolkata), Uttar Pradesh, and globally.

## About Syntalix

Syntalix Consultancy is the brand name of Syntalix LLP (LLPIN: ACR-6280), an India-registered AI/ML engineering consultancy founded in 2025. We provide AI consulting, LLM engineering, agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines, MLOps infrastructure, and enterprise software development to businesses across India and internationally.

We are one of the leading AI consulting companies serving Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot), Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida), Bengaluru, Kolkata, and Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow, Kanpur) — as well as international clients in the United States, United Kingdom, UAE, and Australia.

## Services

- [AI & ML Infrastructure](/services/ai-ml-infrastructure): Custom AI and machine learning systems, MLOps, model training and deployment.
- [LLM Engineering](/services/llm-engineering): Large language model integration, fine-tuning, RAG systems, and prompt engineering.
- [Agentic AI Systems](/services/agentic-systems): Autonomous agent workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI automation.
- [Web & Mobile Development](/services/web-mobile-development): Enterprise websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, and mobile apps.
- [AI Consulting](/services/ai-consulting): Strategic AI consulting — use-case discovery, ROI modelling, AI roadmaps, and implementation for Indian enterprises.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](/services/aeo-optimization): AEO services to get your brand cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude.

## Geographic Service Areas

Primary Indian Markets: Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot), Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow, Kanpur), Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai.
International: United States, United Kingdom, UAE, Australia.
